sourceNote: Verified against Syncfusion .NET MAUI product documentation. Features marked here are confirmed; anything not listed must be treated as unverified and flagged for review.

controls.purpose: Display and manipulate large tabular datasets with sorting, filtering, grouping, selection, paging, and column-level configuration.
verifiedFeatures: Column types (text, numeric, date, image, custom cell templates)
mobileDesignConsiderations: Limit visible columns or use column reordering
Prefer paging on long data
Keep row height touch-friendly
patternsToAvoid: Using DataGrid for short lists under ~10 rows
Displaying AI-generated prose in a grid cell as the main value

controls.purpose: Calendar-style scheduling with appointments, recurrence, and resource-based views for time-based workflows.
verifiedFeatures: Views: Agenda, Day, Week, Work Week, Month, Timeline Day/Week
Resources (e.g. people, rooms) with resource views
possibleAiAssistedOperations: Natural language to structured appointment data
mobileDesignConsiderations: Default to Month or Agenda on small screens
Keep appointment detail in a popup rather than a new page
patternsToAvoid: Using the Scheduler to display non-time-based lists

controls.purpose: Render and interact with chart data: series, axes, annotations, selection, and tooltips.
verifiedFeatures: Series types: column, line, area, pie, donut, bar, spline, scatter, radar, range, stock
possibleAiAssistedOperations: Analyze a dataset and propose series, axes, and annotations
Turn an analysis intent into chart configuration
mobileDesignConsiderations: Limit series count per screen
Use tooltips/trackball for value inspection instead of dense data labels
patternsToAvoid: Showing AI-generated summaries as the only chart content

controls.purpose: Date picking and lightweight month-level appointment display.
typicalCustomerOperations: Pick a date or date range
mobileDesignConsiderations: Prefer over a raw DatePicker when the user benefits from month context
patternsToAvoid: Using Calendar for full appointment management (use Scheduler)

controls.purpose: Single- or multiple-value selection from a list with search and grouping.
mobileDesignConsiderations: Use search for lists over ~20 items
Keep displayed text short
patternsToAvoid: Using it for 2-3 obvious options (a segmented control or toggle is clearer)

controls.purpose: Create and edit rich text documents with formatting operations.
verifiedFeatures: Text formatting (bold, italic, underline, color, alignment)
possibleAiAssistedOperations: Convert user instructions into supported formatting operations applied to a selection
mobileDesignConsiderations: Expose the most-used format actions in a bottom bar
Defer full toolbar behind an expandable view
patternsToAvoid: Using it as a plain multi-line textbox

controls.purpose: View, annotate, and interact with PDF documents.
verifiedFeatures: Annotations: highlight, underline, freehand, text, stamp, arrow
possibleAiAssistedOperations: Create annotation objects (positions + type) to apply to a document
mobileDesignConsiderations: Default to fit-width zoom
Keep annotation palette compact
patternsToAvoid: Using PdfViewer to render app-generated content that could be native views

controls.purpose: Flexible list display with templates, grouping, and pull-to-refresh.
mobileDesignConsiderations: Keep rows 44pt+ for touch
Use sticky headers for long grouped lists
patternsToAvoid: Using SfListView for wide tabular data (use DataGrid)

controls.purpose: Display geographic content with pins, routes, and overlays.
verifiedFeatures: Multiple map providers (e.g. Google Maps, Bing Maps, ArcGIS)
mobileDesignConsiderations: Provide a list alternative for users who prefer scanning over panning
Cache tiles where offline matters
patternsToAvoid: Embedding a map when a static address list answers the question

controls.purpose: Switch between grouped screens with tab or bottom-bar styles.
mobileDesignConsiderations: Limit top-level tabs to 3-5
Keep tab labels short
patternsToAvoid: Using TabView to navigate deep hierarchies

controls.purpose: Show focused content over the current page: dialogs, details, and focused forms.
verifiedFeatures: Close on outside tap or button
typicalCustomerOperations: Review a detail without leaving context
mobileDesignConsiderations: Keep popups to one primary action
Full-screen popups for content-heavy detail
patternsToAvoid: Nesting more than two popup levels
Using a popup to display AI output as the main value of an idea

controls.purpose: Show progress, completion, or a single measured value as a bar or gauge.
verifiedFeatures: Radial gauge with range, needle, and labels
Linear gauge with ranges and pointers
typicalCustomerOperations: See how far along a task is
mobileDesignConsiderations: Pair with a text label stating what the value means
patternsToAvoid: Showing many independent KPIs as a wall of gauges (use a chart or list)

controls.purpose: Let the user select a value or a range along a scale.
mobileDesignConsiderations: Show the selected values as text alongside the slider
patternsToAvoid: Using it for exact data entry (a textbox is better for precise values)

mobileDesignConsiderations: Keep messages to one line where possible
Use for non-critical feedback only
patternsToAvoid: Using toasts for errors that require a response
